description:
When Egypt’s Old Kingdom collapsed, it didn’t fade slowly, it snapped apart in just 20 years. While empires like Rome took centuries to die, Egypt’s first superpower shattered when a massive climate shift caused the Nile to fail, instantly breaking the illusion of the Pharaoh’s divinity. 

Today's insane new video exposes how a civilization engineered entirely around a single point of failure descended into a dark age of brutal civil war, tomb raiding, and social anarchy.
